profile.headline: Graphics Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary:
My love for programming has led me to develop and maintain applications through all my career. As a student I worked on a research laboratory developing image and video processing algorithms for pattern recognition and moving objects detection. I also implemented image processing algorithms on GPGPU architectures.

As an engineer at Intel Corporation I have been learning about Graphics architecture, APIs and specifications; as well as developing, maintaining, and implementing features for validation tools.

Skills: C/C++, Ruby, Software Development, Graphics, Digital Signal Processing,  Artificial Neural Networks, Pattern Recognition, Research, Artificial Vision.

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development, maintenance and feature implementation on Graphics validation tools. Started working on Display/2D, where I worked on validation tools for testing HDMI, DisplayPort, image processing, 
and compression features on Intel products. Then started doing the same for 3D Graphics, enabling validation tools for Vulkan and Direct3D workloads; and GPGPU for compute workloads.

positions.title: Pre-Silicon Validation/Verification Engineer
positions.description: Validation and verification of Network Interface Controllers (NICs). Developed checkers, scoreboards, bus functional models, and tests for NICs verification on SystemVerilog /  Universal Verification Methology.

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description: Development, maintenance and feature implementation on Graphics validation tools. Main focus was on Display Graphics architecture. Software development made under Agile methodologies (Kanban and Scrum).

positions.title: Software Developer at Visual Perception Applications on Robotics Laboratory
positions.description: Development of a graphics user interface for a virtual therapy system on C# and XAML.

positions.title: Researcher at Visual Perception Applications on Robotics Laboratory
positions.description: Research on image and video processing techniques that led to the development of new algorithms for pattern recognition and movement detection. Developed a background substraction model for moving object detection on color-depth (RGB-D) video sequences based on fuzzy classifiers and artificial neural networks, the model was also implemented on C++/CUDA to run on Graphics Processing Units. Developed models for head pose recognition based on biologically inspired models (HMAX) and deep convolutional networks (DCNN).

positions.title: Parallel Algorithms Researcher
positions.description: Research, development and evaluation of parallel execution algorithms on C++ and MATLAB for Graphics Processing Units.
